summary: The change renames the routine schedule protocol to automation schedules across the control plane and the workspace server. It is ready to merge. F3 is fixed: AutomationScheduleSync.test.ts now uses the existing routineTest fixture and checks that only enabled routine-type automations are reported, that saves made during a report are combined into one follow-up report, that failed reports are retried, and that stop aborts an in-flight report. Both test tiers pass, and the coverage gate passes; I accept the remaining exemptions because those lines are rename-only, reformatted PostgreSQL-only code, or entrypoint wiring.
